Not digitised online (no 856 link in the MARC record). The same fonds holds 142 cipher telegrams of 1879-1886 with transcriptions attached and two key sheets: A3039 "Código para escribir en clave" (ca. 1880) and B4931 "Claves telegráficas a utilizar con Lynch, Altamirano, Novoa y todas las legaciones chilenas en el extranjero" (ca. 1883, 10 p.). Not on DECODE, not in the repo (checked 28 Oct 2026).
why: Reports from the occupation command and the Chilean plenipotentiary as Iglesias' government was being installed.
